name: Basic salary
authority: Employment Act 1968 s.20A: salary for an incomplete month is the monthly gross rate × the working days served ÷ the working days in the month (its planned WORK days; calendar days when no schedule is planned). EA s.20A(1)–(2): an incomplete month pays the monthly gross rate × days actually worked ÷ days required to work; a day required to work 5 hours or less counts as half in the days worked. EA s.20A (MOM, Monthly and daily salary: definitions and calculation, https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/salary/monthly-and-daily-salary, updated 8 Dec 2025, read 2026-10-08: incomplete month = monthly gross ÷ the month’s working days, public holidays included, × days worked). A complete month pays the monthly amount ÷ period.parts in each part (a semi-monthly half pays exactly half). An incomplete month (start after the 1st, exit before the last day, or a part not wholly employed) pays the monthly amount × days worked ÷ (period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days); the last part of a month the employment started before settles the month: the s.20A total (the earlier parts’ working days, this part’s worked) less what the month’s earlier slips paid for the code (earned.month), so a leaver recorded after the first half was paid is exact. A ≤ 5-hour required day counts as half in an incomplete month. No-pay and unauthorised days deduct through their own lines at the same divisor. With nothing planned, paid days ÷ the month’s calendar days.
quantity: !(period.covered_working_days < period.working_days || employment.start_date > period.month_from || (employment.exit_date != "" && employment.exit_date < period.month_to)) ? 1.0 / double(period.parts) : double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) > 0.0 ? ((double(period.parts) > 1.0 && period.part == period.parts && employment.start_date <= period.month_from) ? (double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) - double(period.working_days) + (double(period.covered_working_days) - 0.5 * double(size(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "WORK" && d.scheduled_hours > 0.0 && d.scheduled_hours <= 5.0 && d.date >= period.from && d.date <= period.to))))) / double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) - (has(earned.month.BASIC) ? earned.month.BASIC : 0.0) / terms.base_salary : (double(period.covered_working_days) - 0.5 * double(size(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "WORK" && d.scheduled_hours > 0.0 && d.scheduled_hours <= 5.0 && d.date >= period.from && d.date <= period.to)))) / double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days)) : double(period.paid_days) / double(period.month_days)

name: Overtime (1.5×)
authority: Employment Act 1968 s.38(4): overtime at not less than 1.5 times the hourly basic rate; s.38(5) and the Fourth Schedule hourly basic rate = 12 × monthly basic ÷ (52 × 44). For a non-workman earning above SGD 2,250 the overtime rate is computed on SGD 2,250 (MOM, Hours of work and overtime). Part 4 (EA s.35, s.2): statutory overtime applies to a workman earning ≤ $4,500 and any other employee earning ≤ $2,600 basic; outside Part 4 overtime is contractual and not priced here.

name: Incentive hours (1.5×)
authority: Employment Act 1968 s.38(4): overtime at not less than 1.5 times the hourly basic rate; s.38(5) and the Fourth Schedule hourly basic rate = 12 × monthly basic ÷ (52 × 44). For a non-workman earning above SGD 2,250 the overtime rate is computed on SGD 2,250 (MOM, Hours of work and overtime). Part 4 (EA s.35, s.2): statutory overtime applies to a workman earning ≤ $4,500 and any other employee earning ≤ $2,600 basic; outside Part 4 overtime is contractual and not priced here.

name: No-pay leave
authority: Employment Act 1968 s.20A: a day of no-pay leave reduces the month’s salary by the monthly rate ÷ the working days in the month (calendar days when no schedule is planned). EA s.20A divisor (MOM, Monthly and daily salary: definitions and calculation (https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/salary/monthly-and-daily-salary, updated 8 Dec 2025, read 2026-10-08): incomplete month = monthly gross ÷ the month’s working days × days worked, the working days excluding rest and non-working days but including public holidays): period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days, the whole calendar month’s, the same in every part; with nothing planned, the month’s calendar days.
quantity: sum(leave.rows.filter(r, r.activity == "TIME_OFF").map(r, r.is_npl ? r.days : r.days * (1.0 - r.pay_fraction)))

name: WICA medical leave wages
authority: Work Injury Compensation Act 2019 First Schedule para.4(1) (https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/WICA2019?ProvIds=Sc1-, read 2026-10-07); MOM, Types of compensation (https://www.mom.gov.sg/workplace-safety-and-health/work-injury-compensation/types-of-compensation) and the Medical Leave Wage Calculator, read 2026-10-07. Days at full AME (outpatient: the first 14, hospitalisation: the first 60, of the same accident across its rows and periods — taken_before) plus the later days at two-thirds, × the average earnings per day = AME × 12 ÷ (52 × working days a week) (MOM calculator); working days a week from employee.facts.working_days_per_week, else the period’s planned working days, else 7 (calendar days, as leave days are then counted). AME = the average monthly gross of the 12 months before (earned.average; the current monthly wage when there is no history). Compensation, not wages: no CPF, SDL or fund base. Ceiling: AME is read on the payslip month, not the accident month, and includes fixed allowances the AME excludes (transport).
quantity: sum(leave.rows.filter(r, r.code == "WORK_INJURY_MEDICAL_LEAVE" && r.activity == "TIME_OFF").map(r, min(r.days, max(0.0, 14.0 - (has(r.taken_before) ? double(r.taken_before) : 0.0))) + (r.days - min(r.days, max(0.0, 14.0 - (has(r.taken_before) ? double(r.taken_before) : 0.0)))) * 2.0 / 3.0)) + sum(leave.rows.filter(r, r.code == "WORK_INJURY_HOSPITALISATION_LEAVE" && r.activity == "TIME_OFF").map(r, min(r.days, max(0.0, 60.0 - (has(r.taken_before) ? double(r.taken_before) : 0.0))) + (r.days - min(r.days, max(0.0, 60.0 - (has(r.taken_before) ? double(r.taken_before) : 0.0)))) * 2.0 / 3.0))
rate: (has(earned.average) && has(earned.average.months) && earned.average.months > 0 ? earned.average.gross : terms.monthly_wage) * 12.0 / (52.0 * (has(employee.facts.working_days_per_week) ? double(employee.facts.working_days_per_week) : (period.working_days > 0 && period.days > 0 ? double(period.working_days) * 7.0 / double(period.days) : 7.0)))

name: Leave encashment
authority: Employment Act 1968 s.88A(8): an employee dismissed other than for misconduct is paid for untaken annual leave; Employment Act s.20A: a day's pay is the monthly rate divided by the working days in the month (calendar days when no schedule is planned). The tap records the days; this line pays them. EA s.20A divisor (MOM, Monthly and daily salary: definitions and calculation (https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/salary/monthly-and-daily-salary, updated 8 Dec 2025, read 2026-10-08): incomplete month = monthly gross ÷ the month’s working days × days worked, the working days excluding rest and non-working days but including public holidays): period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days, the whole calendar month’s, the same in every part; with nothing planned, the month’s calendar days.
rate: has(employee.facts.working_days_per_week) ? 12.0 * terms.monthly_wage / (52.0 * double(employee.facts.working_days_per_week)) : terms.monthly_wage / (double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) > 0.0 ? double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) : double(period.month_days))

name: Public holiday work (extra day’s basic pay)
authority: Employment Act 1968 s.88(4)–(4A): an employee who works on a public holiday at the employer’s request is paid, besides the gross rate for the day, an extra day’s salary at the basic rate of pay (MOM, Public holidays: entitlement and pay, https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/public-holidays-entitlement-and-pay). MOM, Monthly and daily salary (https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/salary/monthly-and-daily-salary): the daily basic rate is 12 × monthly basic ÷ (52 × the average days the employee is required to work a week). A roster day on a published public or substitute holiday is the work; time off in lieu by agreement is not priced. Part-time employees are paid under the Part-Time Regulations and are not priced here. s.88(4A): an employee outside Part 4 (not a s.35 workman or s.35(b) employee) may instead be given a day off, or part of one, in lieu of the extra day’s salary; record such time off and void the line rather than paying both. Daily basic rate: 12 × monthly basic ÷ (52 × employee.facts.working_days_per_week); where the days a week are not recorded, the monthly basic ÷ the month’s EA s.20A working days (period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days, public holidays included; else the month’s calendar days), so the statutory day is never left unpaid.
quantity: double(size(work.holidays.filter(h, h.worked && h.kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE"] && (h.given_to != "ONLY_IF_OFF_ON_REPLACED_DATE" || (h.replaces != "" && !(h.replaces in work.dates))))))
rate: (has(employee.facts.working_days_per_week) ? 12.0 * terms.base_salary / (52.0 * double(employee.facts.working_days_per_week)) : terms.base_salary / (double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) > 0.0 ? double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) : double(period.month_days)))
eligibility: employment.classification != "NON_EA" && terms.employment_type != "PART_TIME" && size(work.holidays.filter(h, h.worked && h.kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE"] && (h.given_to != "ONLY_IF_OFF_ON_REPLACED_DATE" || (h.replaces != "" && !(h.replaces in work.dates))))) > 0

name: Rest-day work (EA s.37)
authority: Employment Act 1968 s.37(2)–(3) (AGC, read 2026-10-07): a Part 4 employee who works on a rest day at his or her own request is paid half a day’s basic rate for up to half the normal hours, one day’s for more; at the employer’s request one day’s for up to half the normal hours, two days’ for more. Hours beyond the normal hours are overtime (s.37(2)(c)/(3)(c)) and priced by OVERTIME from the approved hours. Daily basic rate per MOM: 12 × monthly basic ÷ (52 × days worked a week). Customer input: employee.facts.rest_day_work_requester (EMPLOYER | EMPLOYEE), required by s.37: without it the slip is held (REST_DAY_WORK_REQUESTER_MISSING); normal_daily_hours, else the planned hours of the employee’s working shift, else the slip is held (REST_DAY_NORMAL_HOURS_MISSING). Daily basic rate: 12 × monthly basic ÷ (52 × employee.facts.working_days_per_week); where the days a week are not recorded, the monthly basic ÷ the month’s EA s.20A working days (period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days, public holidays included; else the month’s calendar days), so the statutory day is never left unpaid.
quantity: sum(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "REST" && d.worked_hours > 0.0).map(d, employee.facts.rest_day_work_requester == "EMPLOYEE" ? (d.worked_hours <= (has(employee.facts.normal_daily_hours) ? double(employee.facts.normal_daily_hours) : size(work.days.filter(w, w.day_type == "WORK" && w.scheduled_hours > 0.0)) > 0 ? double(first(work.days.filter(w, w.day_type == "WORK" && w.scheduled_hours > 0.0).map(w, w.scheduled_hours))) : 0.0) / 2.0 ? 0.5 : 1.0) : (d.worked_hours <= (has(employee.facts.normal_daily_hours) ? double(employee.facts.normal_daily_hours) : size(work.days.filter(w, w.day_type == "WORK" && w.scheduled_hours > 0.0)) > 0 ? double(first(work.days.filter(w, w.day_type == "WORK" && w.scheduled_hours > 0.0).map(w, w.scheduled_hours))) : 0.0) / 2.0 ? 1.0 : 2.0)))
rate: (has(employee.facts.working_days_per_week) ? 12.0 * terms.base_salary / (52.0 * double(employee.facts.working_days_per_week)) : terms.base_salary / (double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) > 0.0 ? double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) : double(period.month_days)))
eligibility: employment.classification != "NON_EA" && ((terms.statutory_work_category != "NON_MANUAL" && terms.base_salary <= 4500.0) || (terms.statutory_work_category == "NON_MANUAL" && terms.base_salary <= 2600.0)) && has(employee.facts.rest_day_work_requester) && (has(employee.facts.normal_daily_hours) ? double(employee.facts.normal_daily_hours) : size(work.days.filter(w, w.day_type == "WORK" && w.scheduled_hours > 0.0)) > 0 ? double(first(work.days.filter(w, w.day_type == "WORK" && w.scheduled_hours > 0.0).map(w, w.scheduled_hours))) : 0.0) > 0.0 && size(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "REST" && d.worked_hours > 0.0)) > 0

name: Part-time public holiday work
authority: Employment (Part-Time Employees) Regulations; MOM, Public holidays for part-time employees (https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/part-time-employment/public-holidays, read 2026-10-07): a part-timer required to work on a public holiday is paid, besides the holiday entitlement, the basic rate of pay for one day’s work — the day’s hours at the hourly basic rate 12 × monthly basic ÷ (52 × contracted weekly hours). Customer input: employee.facts.part_time_weekly_hours.
quantity: sum(work.days.filter(d, has(d.holiday_kind) && d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE"] && d.worked_hours > 0.0).map(d, d.scheduled_hours > 0.0 ? d.scheduled_hours : d.worked_hours))
eligibility: terms.employment_type == "PART_TIME" && has(employee.facts.part_time_weekly_hours) && size(work.days.filter(d, has(d.holiday_kind) && d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE"] && d.worked_hours > 0.0)) > 0

name: Public holiday on a non-working day
authority: Employment Act 1968 s.88(1)(c) (AGC, read 2026-10-07): if a public holiday falls on a day the employee is not required to work, the employer either pays the holiday at the gross rate of pay or gives a day off in substitution. Priced at the gross daily rate unless employee.facts.ph_off_day_compensation is DAY_OFF (customer input: then credit PUBLIC_HOLIDAY_IN_LIEU). A holiday on the rest day moves to the next working day (s.88(1)(b)); the gazetted Sunday substitutes are in the public_holidays calendar. https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/EmA1968 EA s.20A divisor (MOM, Monthly and daily salary: definitions and calculation (https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/salary/monthly-and-daily-salary, updated 8 Dec 2025, read 2026-10-08): incomplete month = monthly gross ÷ the month’s working days × days worked, the working days excluding rest and non-working days but including public holidays): period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days, the whole calendar month’s, the same in every part; with nothing planned, the month’s calendar days.
rate: (has(employee.facts.working_days_per_week) ? 12.0 * terms.monthly_wage / (52.0 * double(employee.facts.working_days_per_week)) : terms.monthly_wage / (double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) > 0.0 ? double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) : double(period.month_days)))
eligibility: employment.classification != "NON_EA" && !(has(employee.facts.ph_off_day_compensation) && employee.facts.ph_off_day_compensation == "DAY_OFF") && work.days.exists(d, has(d.holiday_kind) && d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE"] && d.day_type == "OFF" && !d.worked)

name: Public holiday inside no-pay leave
authority: Employment Act 1968 s.88(2): no holiday pay for a public holiday falling while the employee is on no-pay leave granted at the employee's request. Deducted at the gross daily rate for each unworked holiday a no-pay leave row covers (the leave's own days skip the holiday). https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/EmA1968 EA s.20A divisor (MOM, Monthly and daily salary: definitions and calculation (https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/salary/monthly-and-daily-salary, updated 8 Dec 2025, read 2026-10-08): incomplete month = monthly gross ÷ the month’s working days × days worked, the working days excluding rest and non-working days but including public holidays): period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days, the whole calendar month’s, the same in every part; with nothing planned, the month’s calendar days.
quantity: double(size(work.days.filter(d, has(d.holiday_kind) && d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE"] && !d.worked && leave.rows.exists(r, r.is_npl && r.activity == "TIME_OFF" && r.from <= d.date && d.date <= r.to))))
rate: (has(employee.facts.working_days_per_week) ? 12.0 * terms.monthly_wage / (52.0 * double(employee.facts.working_days_per_week)) : terms.monthly_wage / (double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) > 0.0 ? double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) : double(period.month_days)))
eligibility: employment.classification != "NON_EA" && work.days.exists(d, has(d.holiday_kind) && d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE"] && !d.worked && leave.rows.exists(r, r.is_npl && r.activity == "TIME_OFF" && r.from <= d.date && d.date <= r.to))

name: Holiday pay forfeited for an adjacent unauthorised absence
authority: Employment Act 1968 s.88(3): an employee absent without the employer's prior consent or reasonable excuse on the working day immediately before or after a public holiday is not entitled to holiday pay for it. Customer input: the roster day's facts.unauthorised_absence. Deducted at the gross daily rate per holiday. https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/EmA1968 EA s.20A divisor (MOM, Monthly and daily salary: definitions and calculation (https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/salary/monthly-and-daily-salary, updated 8 Dec 2025, read 2026-10-08): incomplete month = monthly gross ÷ the month’s working days × days worked, the working days excluding rest and non-working days but including public holidays): period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days, the whole calendar month’s, the same in every part; with nothing planned, the month’s calendar days.
quantity: double(size(work.days.filter(h, has(h.holiday_kind) && h.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE"] && !h.worked && work.days.exists(a, a.day_type == "WORK" && !has(a.holiday_kind) && has(a.facts.unauthorised_absence) && a.facts.unauthorised_absence == true && ((a.date < h.date && !work.days.exists(b, b.day_type == "WORK" && !has(b.holiday_kind) && b.date > a.date && b.date < h.date)) || (a.date > h.date && !work.days.exists(b, b.day_type == "WORK" && !has(b.holiday_kind) && b.date < a.date && b.date > h.date)))))))
rate: (has(employee.facts.working_days_per_week) ? 12.0 * terms.monthly_wage / (52.0 * double(employee.facts.working_days_per_week)) : terms.monthly_wage / (double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) > 0.0 ? double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) : double(period.month_days)))

name: Part-time hours beyond full-time normal hours
authority: MOM, Overtime for part-time employees (https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/part-time-employment/overtime), read 2026-10-07, on the Employment (Part-Time Employees) Regulations: hours beyond the contracted daily hours but within a comparable full-time employee’s normal hours are paid at the hourly basic rate; hours beyond the full-time normal hours at 1.5 × it (MOM example: 4 contracted hours, 8 full-time, 9 worked = 4 × rate + 1 × 1.5 × rate). Hourly basic rate = 12 × monthly basic ÷ (52 × contracted weekly hours). Read on each scheduled working day from the recorded hours; customer input: employee.facts.part_time_weekly_hours, full_time_daily_hours (default 8, EA s.38(1)(b)).
quantity: sum(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "WORK" && d.scheduled_hours > 0.0 && d.worked_hours > d.scheduled_hours).map(d, max(0.0, d.worked_hours - max((has(employee.facts.full_time_daily_hours) ? double(employee.facts.full_time_daily_hours) : 8.0), d.scheduled_hours))))

name: Part-time extra hours within full-time normal hours
authority: MOM, Overtime for part-time employees (https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/part-time-employment/overtime), read 2026-10-07, on the Employment (Part-Time Employees) Regulations: hours beyond the contracted daily hours but within a comparable full-time employee’s normal hours are paid at the hourly basic rate; hours beyond the full-time normal hours at 1.5 × it (MOM example: 4 contracted hours, 8 full-time, 9 worked = 4 × rate + 1 × 1.5 × rate). Hourly basic rate = 12 × monthly basic ÷ (52 × contracted weekly hours). Read on each scheduled working day from the recorded hours; customer input: employee.facts.part_time_weekly_hours, full_time_daily_hours (default 8, EA s.38(1)(b)).
quantity: sum(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "WORK" && d.scheduled_hours > 0.0 && d.worked_hours > d.scheduled_hours).map(d, max(0.0, min(d.worked_hours, (has(employee.facts.full_time_daily_hours) ? double(employee.facts.full_time_daily_hours) : 8.0)) - d.scheduled_hours)))
